name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
about: Pidilite Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, craftsmen products, DIY  products and polymer emulsions in India. Most of the products have been developed through strong in-house R&D. Our brand name Fevicol has become synonymous with adhesives to millions in India and is ranked amongst the most trusted brands in the country. Some of our other major brands are M-Seal, Fevikwik, Fevistik, Roff, Dr. Fixit, Fevicryl, Motomax, Hobby Ideas, Araldite.

flags.text: Operating margin expanded 7.0 pts in 3 years (17% → 24%).
Profit compounding faster than sales (PAT 24.2% vs revenue 7.4% 3y CAGR) — operating leverage.
Operating cash ≥ reported profit over 5 years (1.18x) — earnings are real.

docs.label: Nov 2026
docs.tone_why: Management balances strong volume performance against significant raw material volatility and geopolitical uncertainty.

guidance.statement: Management remains confident of delivering EBITDA margins within the established corridor for the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: we remain very confident of Q3 and quite confident of the full second half that we should be able to deliver in our EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24%

guidance.statement: The company aims to maintain double-digit underlying volume growth despite macroeconomic challenges and inflationary pressures.
guidance.quote: we stay firmly focused on trying delivering double-digit underlying volume growth even under these trying circumstances.

guidance.statement: Management desires to gradually increase underlying volume growth from current levels to early teens over time.
guidance.quote: we want to take this from classic double digit to early teens. I think that's the desire over a period of time.

guidance.statement: The company expects its volume growth to continue outperforming the national GDP growth rate.
guidance.quote: If the country's growth is in the 6.5, 7 range in real terms, our UVG growth should remain double digit

pushback.concern: Analysts questioned the delay in pricing actions despite significantly elevated VAM and crude-linked input costs.
Impact of 12-15% price hikes on future demand sustainability given macroeconomic uncertainty.
Whether the company will set up its own VAM plant to mitigate supply chain volatility.

achieved.claim: Delivered 11% underlying volume growth for the first half of the fiscal year.
International subsidiaries grew revenue by 21.8% with EBITDA growth of 53%.
Domestic subsidiaries delivered strong revenue growth of 22.2% led by Consumer and Bazaar.
Maintained double-digit underlying volume growth for approximately 6 to 8 consecutive quarters.

docs.label: Aug 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlights strong volume growth, market share gains, and successful proactive pricing despite geopolitical headwinds.

guidance.statement: Management intends to maintain an EBITDA margin corridor to provide operating flexibility despite recent high performance.
guidance.quote: we would still prefer to keep a corridor, which gives us enough operating flexibility. So no need to change it at this stage.

guidance.statement: The company expects core growth categories to grow at a multiple of real GDP.
guidance.quote: we always indexed our growth of our categories to a multiple of the real GDP growth.

guidance.statement: Management expects growth businesses to deliver significantly higher volume growth than core categories.
guidance.quote: For our growth businesses... we are in the range of 2x to 4x, but we are seeing accelerated momentum.

guidance.statement: The company aims to deliver consistent double-digit underlying volume growth.
guidance.quote: I think we have always maintained that we will deliver double digit. As a matter of fact, our endeavor will be to slowly but surely inch it up.

guidance.statement: Management anticipates margins could reach the upper end of their guidance if commodity prices remain stable.
guidance.quote: your assumption is correct that we would manage the business well within the band. And it is quite possible that we could be middle to higher end.

pushback.concern: Whether double-digit price hikes are excessive given recent falls in raw material costs.
Impact of new competition from cement and tile manufacturers in the adhesive segment.
Sustainability of high margins given the benefit of low-cost inventory this quarter.
Potential for channel upstocking to have artificially inflated Q1 volume growth numbers.

achieved.claim: Standalone revenues grew by 22.2% with underlying volume growth of 11.3%.
Consolidated profit after tax grew by 30.3% during the quarter.
Standalone EBITDA margins improved to 26.4%, up 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
Consumer and Bazaar domestic subsidiaries recorded revenue growth of 17%.

docs.label: May 2026

guidance.statement: Management stays committed to maintaining an EBITDA margin corridor despite raw material inflation.

guidance.statement: Capital expenditure is expected to remain within the historical range of revenue turnover.

guidance.statement: The company aims to systematically raise underlying volume growth year-on-year.

The strategic rationale behind swapping BuildNext for an insignificant stake in JSW One.

achieved.claim: Delivered 15.3% underlying volume growth in Q4 FY26.
Consolidated revenue reached INR 14,553 crores for the full year FY26.
EBITDA margin expanded by 310 basis points in the current quarter.

achieved.claim: Domestic business reported underlying volume growth of 11% despite export challenges.

Consumer and Bazaar business achieved underlying volume growth of 9.7%.

segments.note: Adhesives, sealants, art and craft, construction and paint chemicals

segments.name: Business to Business

Growth across industries such as packaging, textiles, paints, and construction

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Pidilite demonstrates exceptional operational discipline, consistently delivering double-digit volume growth and high margins. However, recent margin compression and evasiveness regarding raw material self-sufficiency warrant caution for future profitability.

promises.promise: Maintain EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24%.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show annual operating margin of 24.0% for FY26.
promises.why: Management hit the top end of their guided range.

promises.promise: Deliver consistent double-digit underlying volume growth.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show 11.3% volume growth in Q1 FY27 and 11% in H1 FY27.
promises.why: Volume growth has remained above 10% for several quarters.

promises.promise: Maintain EBITDA margin corridor despite raw material volatility.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q2 FY27 operating margin fell to 20.0%.
promises.why: Currently at the bottom of the range; management remains confident for H2.

promises.promise: Keep capital expenditure within a specific range of revenue.
promises.actual: Evidence missing for actual FY27 capex spend vs revenue.
promises.why: Full year FY27 data is required to verify the 3-5% band.

promises.promise: Bring B2B segment growth back to specific levels.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q4 FY26 revenue grew 14.1% YoY.
promises.why: Revenue growth reached the mid-teens target in the specified quarter.

promises.promise: Increase underlying volume growth to early teens over time.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 20.9% YoY.
promises.why: Revenue growth is accelerating, though volume-specific split for Q2 is not detailed.

credibility.line: Management consistently hits volume and margin targets, though they occasionally provide partial or evasive answers regarding competitive threats and input cost mitigation.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claimed profit is compounding faster than sales due to operating leverage.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers confirm 3y PAT CAGR of 24.2% vs revenue CAGR of 7.4%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management stated they would manage margins within the 20-24% band.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show margins hit exactly 20.0% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims strong volume growth is driven by domestic subsidiaries.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q1 FY27 revenue grew 21.3% YoY.

bull.point: Strong cash flow generation supports growth.
bull.evidence: Operating cash is 1.18x reported profit over 5 years.

bull.point: Dominant market position with a clean balance sheet.

bull.evidence: Cash conversion cycle tightened from 88 to 66 days.

bear.point: Margin pressure from input cost volatility.
bear.evidence: Operating margins dropped from 26% to 20% in one quarter.

bear.point: Significant contingent liabilities from tax disputes.
bear.evidence: Disputed tax claims total over ₹377 crore.

bear.point: Evasive management regarding supply chain risks.
bear.evidence: Management gave an evasive answer regarding a VAM plant.

watch_next: Whether Q3 FY27 margins recover from the 20% floor.
Sustainability of 20%+ revenue growth amid price hike pushback.
Resolution of ₹207 crore income tax demand appeal.
